title: Avoid AI writing
summary: Finds and removes the patterns that make prose read as machine-generated, without adding a fake voice or invented facts.
changes: Rewrote the frontmatter description to start with 'Use when' and fit 300 characters; it now names articles, newsletters, scripts and stories alongside docs.

Added a 'fiction' context profile: listed in SKILL.md step 1 and the --context options, plus an auto-detection row and a 'Fiction and dialogue profile' section in references/profiles.md that protects dialogue and relaxes the em-dash, rhythm, rule-of-three and rhetorical-question rules for narrative prose.
